design configurator prototype

by Raphael Jung, TU Delft

 

When the supply of NdFeB magnets is disrupted for European EV manufacturers, their production rates drop and orders are lost. Pick motor design choices, combine them in any sequence, and see how many previously lost orders each one saves, and where design choices form synergies.
